messages:
Iris: quick flag 60min review: when you open Console > Models on a narrow phone the Instances table squeezes rows to tiny line-height. Users can't comfortably tap the action icons. Thoughts on switching to 'compact rows + inline expand' instead of a slide-over?

Ken: saw that on Pixel 4a. Repro: Console > Models > Instance list, set text size to 110% (user pref) and you get overlap.

Aria: Inline expand could keep context (you don't lose row position) but might push content below fold. Slide-over (right panel) keeps the list stable but is awkward on narrow widths.

Leo: proposal: for viewport <=560px use compact rows (48px min) and an inline accordion that expands beneath the row for details. For <=360px fallback to a full-screen modal for details.

Iris: important accessibility notes: accordion must toggle aria-expanded on the row button and update an aria-live region announcing "Details opened for <instance-name>". Also ensure the expanded content is focusable and keyboard-accessible.

Ken: if we do inline expand, watch performance for long lists. Virtualized list + dynamic height expansion = jumpy. We might need to reserve a height placeholder or reflow carefully.

Aria: UX copy tweak: change the action menu item from "Open" to "Open details" to remove ambiguity with other "Open" actions. Also add a hint under small rows: "Tap for details" as visually hidden text for screen readers.

Leo: prototype CSS snippet for the accordion approach: 
```css
.row { min-height: 48px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; }
.row + .expanded { transform-origin: top; will-change: transform, opacity; transition: transform 180ms ease, opacity 120ms linear; }
```

QA-Bot: Automated regression note: add tests for reduce-motion and keyboard expand/collapse. Flag: DES-3499 created for infra + qa. https://redwood.design/tasks/DES-3499

Iris: design question: do we keep the right-hand metadata column on tablets only (>720px) and remove it on phones? I think yes. Also decide if expanded inline view includes the same set of controls as the desktop slide-over (edit, restart, logs).

Ken: prefer parity of controls. If we hide some actions in inline view, surface the important ones (Restart, Logs) and put secondary actions under "More".

Aria: color/accessibility nit: small gray label used for status dots is #9CA3AF which fails contrast on dark mode. Recommend swapping to #9AA7B8 or adding bold weight.

Leo: will add a motion spec: expansion should use translateY + opacity only (no layout thrash), and respect prefers-reduced-motion.

Iris: can someone mock both inline expand and slide-over variants in Figma? I'll run a quick user task with 5 folks to get preference. Priya from research volunteered in the meeting.

Ken: also watch native back gestures on iOS if we use full-screen modal; provide a clear close affordance and escape key binding.

Aria: uploaded Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/def456/compact-rows-inline-expand (notes on focus and labels included).

QA-Bot: Reminder: attach acceptance criteria to DES-3499: keyboard nav, aria-live announcement, reduced-motion support, control parity, and 44px min tap targets.
